e: Amplitude of accommodation declines c̅ age; ~+14D is typical around 7 years (Duane's curve).
Retrobulbar neuritis: painful ↓ vision c̅ RAPD and a normal disc (patient sees nothing, doctor sees nothing).
APACG: sudden pain, halos, mid-dilated fixed pupil, hazy cornea, ↑ IOP.
Ring infiltrate in a contact-lens wearer → Acanthamoeba keratitis; calcofluor white stains the cyst wall.
Krukenberg spindle (pigment on corneal endothelium) → pigmentary glaucoma.
ETDRS needs letter recognition – not for preverbal children (OKN drum, Teller, Cardiff cards are used).
Acute hydrops in keratoconus (Descemet break): intracameral gas (C₃F₈/SF₆) tamponade.
Frontal eye field (Brodmann area 8) controls voluntary scanning/saccades.
